strategy.cross_dataset_primary: flow_compatible_CICIDS_Edge_BoT plus explicit N-BaIoT source_aggregate profile
strategy.universal_four_dataset_note: A strict raw-feature universal profile across all four datasets is not scientifically defensible because N-BaIoT contains pre-aggregated KitNET traffic statistics rather than the same raw flow fields used by CICIDS2017, Edge-IIoTset and BoT-IoT.

features.name: duration_seconds
features.semantic_definition: Current flow duration normalized to seconds.
features.transformation: CICIDS Flow Duration microseconds / 1e6; BoT dur seconds; Edge udp.time_delta where available.
features.missing_behavior: NaN when no defensible duration field exists.

features.name: protocol_family
features.semantic_definition: Transport/protocol family.
features.transformation: Use explicit proto where available; infer coarse tcp/udp/icmp from Edge fields.
features.missing_behavior: Excluded from universal flow profile; usable for dataset/pair profiles.

features.name: connection_state
features.semantic_definition: Connection state/flags summary.
features.transformation: BoT state only.

features.name: src_port
features.semantic_definition: Source transport port.
features.transformation: Direct numeric mapping where present.

features.name: dst_port
features.semantic_definition: Destination transport/service port.
features.transformation: CICIDS Destination Port; Edge tcp.dstport/udp.port; BoT dport.

features.name: total_packets
features.semantic_definition: Total packet count in current flow.
features.transformation: CICIDS fwd+bwd packet counts; BoT pkts.
features.missing_behavior: NaN for Edge prepared CSV and N-BaIoT.

features.name: fwd_packets
features.semantic_definition: Forward/source packet count in current flow.
features.transformation: CICIDS Total Fwd Packets; BoT spkts.

features.name: bwd_packets
features.semantic_definition: Backward/destination packet count in current flow.
features.transformation: CICIDS Total Backward Packets; BoT dpkts.

features.name: total_bytes
features.semantic_definition: Total bytes/length observed for current record.
features.transformation: CICIDS fwd+bwd lengths; BoT bytes; Edge tcp/mqtt/http length sum when present.
features.missing_behavior: NaN when no length field exists.

features.name: fwd_bytes
features.semantic_definition: Forward/source bytes.
features.transformation: CICIDS Total Length of Fwd Packets; BoT sbytes.

features.name: bwd_bytes
features.semantic_definition: Backward/destination bytes.
features.transformation: CICIDS Total Length of Bwd Packets; BoT dbytes.

features.name: bytes_per_second
features.semantic_definition: Current flow byte rate.
features.transformation: CICIDS Flow Bytes/s; BoT rate.

features.name: packets_per_second
features.semantic_definition: Current flow packet rate.
features.transformation: CICIDS Flow Packets/s only.

features.name: packet_length_mean
features.semantic_definition: Mean/current packet length statistic.
features.transformation: CICIDS Packet Length Mean; BoT mean; Edge record payload length as weaker proxy.
features.missing_behavior: NaN when unavailable; Edge proxy documented.

features.name: packet_length_std
features.semantic_definition: Packet length standard deviation within current flow.
features.transformation: CICIDS Packet Length Std; BoT stddev.

features.name: packet_length_min
features.semantic_definition: Minimum packet length in current flow.
features.transformation: CICIDS Min Packet Length; BoT min.

features.name: packet_length_max
features.semantic_definition: Maximum packet length in current flow.
features.transformation: CICIDS Max Packet Length; BoT max.

features.name: flow_iat_mean
features.semantic_definition: Source-provided mean inter-arrival time within flow.
features.transformation: CICIDS Flow IAT Mean only.

features.name: flow_iat_std
features.semantic_definition: Source-provided inter-arrival variability within flow.
features.transformation: CICIDS Flow IAT Std only.

features.name: source_provided_delta_seconds
features.semantic_definition: Source-provided packet/UDP delta time when available.
features.transformation: Edge udp.time_delta only.

features.name: timestamp_start
features.semantic_definition: Start timestamp for ordering/causal feature generation.
features.transformation: BoT stime only; metadata not direct model feature.

features.name: source_host
features.semantic_definition: Source entity key for causal behavioral feature generation.
features.transformation: Edge ip.src_host; BoT saddr.
features.missing_behavior: Metadata only, never direct model input.

features.name: destination_host
features.semantic_definition: Destination entity key for causal behavioral feature generation.
features.transformation: Edge ip.dst_host; BoT daddr.
features.missing_behavior: Metadata only, never direct model input.

features.name: traffic_asymmetry
features.semantic_definition: Directional byte imbalance for current flow: (forward - backward) / total bytes.
features.transformation: Derived from fwd/bwd bytes where available.

features.name: packet_direction_ratio
features.semantic_definition: Forward/backward packet count ratio for current flow.
features.transformation: fwd_packets / (bwd_packets + 1).

features.name: source_agg_*
features.semantic_definition: N-BaIoT source-provided KitNET damped-window host/host-pair traffic behavior statistics over historical decay windows.
features.transformation: Preserve numeric MI_dir/H/HH/HH_jit/HpHp aggregate columns with source_agg_ prefix.

features.name: temporal_causal_count
features.semantic_definition: Rolling count of recent causal observations from the same source.
features.transformation: Causal rolling count grouped by source_host.

features.name: behavioral_dest_diversity
features.semantic_definition: Historical count of unique destination hosts contacted by this source.
features.transformation: Rolling set count of destination_host grouped by source_host.
features.missing_behavior: NaN when host identifiers are missing.
